items.headline: Spain Edges Belgium in Thrilling Quarter-Final
items.body: Spain secured a hard-fought 2-1 victory over Belgium in a captivating Quarter-Final clash. The match, held at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, saw Spain advance to the semi-finals.

items.headline: Brazil Overcomes Netherlands in Tense Encounter
items.body: Brazil advanced to the semi-finals after defeating the Netherlands 2-1 in a tightly contested Quarter-Final. The South American giants showcased their resilience at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, setting up a highly anticipated next round.

metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

items.headline: Spain to Face Brazil in Blockbuster Semi-Final
items.body: The first semi-final will feature a clash of titans as Spain takes on Brazil. Both teams have displayed exceptional form throughout the tournament, promising an intense battle for a spot in the final at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia.

items.headline: France and England Set for European Showdown
items.body: France and England are set to reignite their rivalry in the second semi-final, following their respective Quarter-Final victories. This highly anticipated European derby will take place at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, with a place in the World Cup final at stake.

items.headline: Richarlison's Form Propels Brazil
items.body: Brazil's Richarlison has been in scintillating form, consistently delivering crucial goals and high-energy performances. His clinical finishing and relentless work rate have been key factors in Brazil's progression to the semi-finals.

items.headline: Mbappé Sustains Minor Knock
items.body: Reports indicate that France's star forward Kylian Mbappé sustained a minor knock during their Quarter-Final match. While not considered serious, his fitness will be closely monitored ahead of the crucial semi-final clash against England.

items.headline: Defensive Solidity Key for Spain
items.body: Spain's tactical approach has emphasized defensive solidity, allowing them to control games and launch effective counter-attacks. Their disciplined backline and midfield pressing have proven difficult for opponents to break down.

items.headline: England's Attacking Depth Shines
items.body: England has demonstrated impressive attacking depth, with multiple players capable of scoring and creating chances. Their ability to rotate offensive threats and adapt their attacking patterns has made them a formidable force in the tournament.
